title: RRB Group D 27 Nov 2025 Shift 1 - General Awareness - Current Affairs
subject: General Awareness

questions.q: On 24 May 2025, the order of which High Court was overturned by the Supreme Court and ruled that denying maternity leave for a third child violates a woman's constitutional right, reinforcing her dignity and reproductive freedom?
questions.explain: On 24 May 2025, the Supreme Court overturned a Madras High Court order that had denied maternity leave for a third child. The apex court ruled that such denial violates a woman's constitutional right to reproductive freedom.
questions.subject: General Awareness

questions.q: Which of the following new digital facilities was launched in May 2025 by the Union Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment during the ‘Ageing with Dignity’ event?
options: Employment Exchange Portal for Senior Citizens
questions.explain: The Union Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment launched the Senior Citizens Welfare Portal in May 2025 to digitally facilitate various welfare services for the elderly.
questions.subject: General Awareness

questions.q: In 2025, which city in Maharashtra has achieved 100% segregation, collection and processing of sanitary and biomedical waste, handling an average of 300 to 350 kg of sanitary waste daily?
questions.explain: Karad, a city in Maharashtra, set a notable sanitation benchmark in 2025 by achieving 100% segregation, collection, and processing of its sanitary and biomedical waste.
questions.subject: General Awareness

questions.q: Who authored the book 'Test Cricket: A History', released in 2025?
questions.explain: The book 'Test Cricket: A History', which was published and released in 2025, was authored by cricket writer and journalist Tim Wigmore.
questions.subject: General Awareness

questions.q: Which chess player, besides Gukesh, received the Arjuna Award in 2025?
questions.explain: In 2025, the Arjuna Award for outstanding performance in Chess was awarded to Vantika Agrawal, alongside notable players like D. Gukesh.
questions.subject: General Awareness

questions.q: Which of the following documentaries did the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) launch to explain its functions to the public in June 2025?
questions.explain: In June 2025, the Reserve Bank of India launched an informative documentary titled 'RBI Unlocked: Beyond the Rupee' to better explain its multifaceted role and operations to the general public.
questions.subject: General Awareness

questions.q: Which Indian Ministry launched the Bharat Forecasting System (BFS) on 26 May 2025 to provide weather predictions with a 6-km resolution?
options: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
questions.explain: The Ministry of Earth Sciences launched the Bharat Forecasting System (BFS) on May 26, 2025. It is designed to offer high-resolution (6-km) weather predictions across India.
questions.subject: General Awareness

questions.q: Which startup was selected in April 2025 to build India's first sovereign Indic LLM under the IndiaAI Mission?
questions.explain: Under the government's IndiaAI Mission in April 2025, the AI startup Sarvam AI was officially selected to build and deploy India's first sovereign large language model (LLM) focusing on Indic languages.
questions.subject: General Awareness

questions.q: As reported in May 2025, the study by Climate Trends, a Delhi-based research consultancy, examined NASA satellite data of the Himalayan glaciers from 2000-2023 to evaluate the impact of which of the following on Himalayan snow?
questions.explain: A study by the consultancy Climate Trends analyzed NASA satellite data spanning over two decades to evaluate how black carbon deposits are accelerating the melting of Himalayan snow and glaciers.
questions.subject: General Awareness

questions.q: The National Conference on Good Governance, organised by the Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG) was held in which of the following places in January 2025?
questions.explain: In January 2025, the Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG) organized the National Conference on Good Governance in Gandhinagar, Gujarat.
questions.subject: General Awareness

questions.q: What was the theme of the $78^{th}$ World Health Assembly, 2025, held in Geneva in May 2025?
options: Health for All: Building Resilient Systems
Universal Health Coverage: A Global Need
questions.explain: The theme for the 78th session of the World Health Assembly, held in Geneva, Switzerland in May 2025, was 'One World for Health'.
questions.subject: General Awareness

questions.q: As announced by the Government of India, as on 7 July 2025, how many biotech startups does India have, compared to just 50 a decade ago?
questions.explain: According to official announcements by the Government of India in July 2025, the number of biotech startups in the country witnessed exponential growth, expanding from around 50 a decade ago to nearly 11,000.
questions.subject: General Awareness

questions.q: Which of the following awards recognises children's book writers from 22 languages?
questions.explain: According to the official exam key provided in the source, Sahitya Akademi Yuva Puraskar is marked as the correct option here, recognizing young writers (along with children's authors often overlapping or assessed under Sahitya Akademi awards across multiple recognized languages).
questions.subject: General Awareness

questions.q: On 16 May 2025, the Supreme Court invalidated the Indian Government's orders passed in which years, allowing ex-post facto environmental clearances?
questions.explain: On 16 May 2025, the Supreme Court struck down specific orders passed by the Ministry of Environment in the years 2017 and 2021. The Court ruled against the practice of granting ex-post facto environmental clearances.
questions.subject: General Awareness

questions.q: Where did the chemical factory blast occur on 30 June 2025?
questions.explain: A major industrial accident occurred on 30 June 2025 when a chemical factory experienced a massive blast in the Sangareddy district.
questions.subject: General Awareness

questions.q: Which state became the third Indian state to be recognised as fully functionally literate, under the ULLAS – New India Literacy Programme, in June 2025?
questions.explain: In June 2025, Tripura achieved a significant educational milestone by becoming the third state in India to be recognized as fully functionally literate under the ULLAS (Understanding Lifelong Learning for All in Society) initiative.
questions.subject: General Awareness

questions.q: Which of the following shifted its Andhra Pradesh regional office to Vijayawada, inaugurating the new premises on 16 June 2025?
options: Securities and Exchange Board of India
questions.explain: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) inaugurated its new premises and shifted its Andhra Pradesh regional office to Vijayawada on June 16, 2025, expanding its operational footprint in the state.
questions.subject: General Awareness

questions.q: India set a new Guinness World Record in 2025 for the largest human formation of which of the following symbols?
questions.explain: In 2025, India achieved a Guinness World Record by successfully creating the largest human formation in the shape of the Ashoka Chakra.
questions.subject: General Awareness

questions.q: India won the ICC Women’s U19 T20 World Cup 2025 by defeating which country in the final?
questions.explain: In the ICC Women's U19 T20 World Cup held in 2025, the Indian team secured the championship by defeating South Africa in the final match.
questions.subject: General Awareness

questions.q: Which sport had the most Arjuna Award recipients in January 2025?
questions.explain: During the National Sports Awards announcements in January 2025, the discipline of Para-Athletics featured the highest number of athletes receiving the prestigious Arjuna Award.
